Container.Name: dwellmind-ha
Container.Overview: Local DwellMind worker for the Home Assistant integration. Select rooms and entities in HA, not this template. Observation only: captures start explicitly from HA and preserve unknown/offline intervals. No HA access token required. Pairing key is generated privately in appdata/service-token. Keep the API on a trusted local network; use HTTPS through your local reverse proxy when possible. No add-on needed.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private history and pairing key. Use a new empty directory or a previously prepared directory owned by PUID with mode 0700. No old data is deleted.

Config.Name: Worker API port
Config.Description: Local authenticated API for the HA integration. Never expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: Runtime mode
Config.Description: HA companion worker. Legacy standalone capture remains available from the command line.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root worker identity; root only initializes an empty mount.
